items.titleZh: 博塔斯解释巴库站大幅落后佩雷兹的原因
items.summaryZh: 博塔斯透露，在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上他平均每圈比凯迪拉克队友佩雷兹慢超过1.7秒，是2026赛季迄今正赛中最大的队内差距，他对此表示在直道和弯角都无法跟上节奏。
items.originalTitle: The slowest race of F1 2026 explained
items.summaryEn: Valtteri Bottas has revealed why he was on average more than 1.7 seconds per lap slower than his Cadillac team-mate Sergio Perez at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, the largest race-day intra-team deficit of the 2026 season so far.
detailZh: 瓦尔特里·博塔斯透露了上一站巴库比赛中，他相比凯迪拉克F1队友塞尔吉奥·佩雷兹速度严重不足的一些原因。
在阿塞拜疆大奖赛上，博塔斯平均每圈比佩雷兹慢超过1.7秒之多，这是2026赛季迄今正赛中最大的队内差距。甚至他的最快单圈也比佩雷兹慢1.489秒。
博塔斯在最后一圈撞上护墙，因为他在驶过1号弯逃生通道后，赛车的能量输出模式“有点混乱”，而由于多跑了距离，他在进入15号弯左弯时后刹车失效，车头撞上了护墙。
但更令人担忧的是此前惊人的速度差距，在博塔斯撞车之前，佩雷兹几乎已经套了他一圈。
“我理解从外面看起来情况很糟糕，坐在车里感觉也很糟糕，”博塔斯周四在马来西亚说。
“当时根本没办法跟上大部队。我在比赛中尝试了所有办法，也得到了很多关于我在哪里损失时间的反馈。很大一部分是在直道上，但也有相当大的一部分是在整圈的弯道中损失掉的。
“所以我一直在坚持推进直到最后，这也是为什么我在最后一圈进一号弯时锁死了轮胎。
“不过是的，关键问题是在练习中我们就已经看到我的速度不够。我无法像佩雷兹那样以同样的速度过弯，所以我们在排位赛前做了很多改动，包括一些减震器和底板，结果感觉确实好多了。
“但在正赛中，行驶品质又明显衰减了很多……我们这次改动了很多东西，所以我觉得问题在于减震器随温度衰减，还有底板……我们在某些地方仍然缺少一些压力测量点，所以对于气动部件，我还拿不到过去习惯获得的完整信息。
“通过数据你马上就能看出性能是提升还是下降，但现在底板有一些区域我们完全看不见。不过就我个人的感觉而言，更多问题出在行驶品质上——再加上动力转向整个周末都在不断衰减。所以我在整场比赛中真的很难去感受赛车。
“这些因素叠加在一起。而且动力单元的差距可能比我们预想的要大，至少从数据上看是这样。
“理论上我们有一个数字，但那是新引擎对全新引擎，也就是新规格对旧规格的对比。所以，我想就是这些因素叠加的结果。我当时确实相当慢。”
动力单元方面的差异指的是佩雷兹在巴库已经用上了升级版 ADUO 2 法拉利引擎，而博塔斯还没有。
此前这被描述为“细微差别”，但正如博塔斯所说，这次升级的效果可能比最初想象的更大。
博塔斯表示，他的 ADUO 2 引擎能否及时送到、让他能在雪邦赛道使用，可能性是“五五开”；如果赶不上，他就得等到下周的新加坡大奖赛。
他的队友佩雷兹本周末不会使用这套引擎，而是换用自己引擎池中的另一套动力单元，以便把升级版留到更能发挥作用的比赛周末再使用。
佩雷斯解释说：“我们做出了一个我们认为胜算最大的决定。”
“这就是为什么我们会在这里承受一些损失。但我们希望这会有所回报。”
“我们对这个周末并不太乐观。所以我们决定把它省下来。”
正如佩雷斯所暗示的，凯迪拉克的车手们已经为艰难的周末做好了准备，因为雪邦赛道带来了两个凯迪拉克尤其难以应对的挑战：轮胎过热和高速弯角。
正如佩雷兹所解释的，凯迪拉克目前“赛车的下压力严重不足，而且阻力很大”。
“在巴库，我基本上整场比赛都保持在超车模式上，所以才能跟住其他车手，”佩雷兹说。
“但当我超过他们之后，我就只能像个乘客一样，因为我没有直道速度。所以我们有两大问题：下压力不足和很大的阻力。”
“但我们一直都知道，第一年会很艰难。”
detailEn: Valtteri Bottas has revealed some of the reasons behind his woeful lack of pace compared to Cadillac Formula 1 team-mate Sergio Perez last time out in Baku.

Bottas was on average over a whopping 1.7 seconds slower than Perez per lap at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, the largest race day intra-team deficit of 2026 so far. Even his single fastest lap was 1.489s slower than Perez.

Bottas ended up in the wall on the final lap as his car’s deployment pattern “got a bit confused” because he went down the Turn 1 escape road, then because of the extra distance travelled his rear brakes didn’t work going into the Turn 15 left-hander, where he nosed into the barriers.
But what was more worrying was the alarming lack of pace before then, with Perez close to lapping Bottas before the latter's crash.
“I understand it looked pretty bad from the outside and felt pretty bad in the car as well,” Bottas said on Thursday in Malaysia.

“There was just no way to keep up with the pack. I tried everything during the race, and got lots of feedback on where I am losing the time. A lot of it was on the straights, but also a big chunk was just all around the lap in the corners.
“That's why I just kept pushing until the end and that's why I had to lock up on the last lap into Turn 1.

“But yeah, the main thing was we saw already in practice that I was lacking pace. I couldn't carry the same speed through the corners as Checo, so we changed a lot for the qualifying, including some dampers and the floor, and it actually felt a lot better.

“But then the ride again during the race degraded quite a lot... Again, we've changed a lot of things, so I think it's something to do with dampers degging with heat, the floor... We are still lacking a bit of pressure tappings here and there, so we still don't have the full information on aero parts that I'm used to from the past.

“You can immediately see if you're down or up, but now there are some bits of the floor where we are blind. But for me, feeling-wise, it was more the ride - that, in combination with the power steering that was degging throughout the weekend. So I was really then also struggling to feel the car throughout the race.
“So those things combined. And then the [power unit] difference was probably bigger than we thought, at least from the data.
“We've got a number in theory, but that's new engine versus new one, of the new and old spec. So yeah, I think those combined. I was pretty slow.”
The power unit difference is in reference to Perez having the upgraded ADUO 2 Ferrari engine in Baku while Bottas doesn’t yet have it.
This was previously described as a “small difference”, but as Bottas says the upgrade may be more powerful than first thought.
Bottas says it’s “50/50” if his ADUO 2 engine arrives in time for him to run it at Sepang; if not, he’ll have to wait until next week in Singapore.
Team-mate Perez won’t be running it this weekend, swapping to a different power unit in his pool in order to save it for a weekend when it will be more beneficial.
“We took a decision where we feel we got the best shot at it,” Perez explained.
“That's why we're taking a bit of a hit here. But we hope that it will pay us back.
“We are not too optimistic about this weekend. So we decided to save it.”
As Perez alluded, the Cadillac drivers are braced for a difficult weekend because Sepang poses two challenges the Cadillac struggles with in particular: tyre overheating and high-speed corners.
As Perez explains, the Cadillac has “a massive lack of load in the car and a lot of drag” right now.
“In Baku, I basically stayed on the overtake mode for the entire race and therefore I was able to stay with the others,” Perez said.
“But when I overtook them, I was just a passenger because I had no straightline speed. So we have two big issues: load and a lot of drag.
“But we always knew this first year was going to be tricky.”
keyPointsZh: 博塔斯的最快单圈也比佩雷兹慢1.489秒

keyPointsEn: Bottas's fastest single lap was still 1.489s slower than Perez's

items.originalTitle: Toyota denies 2027 WEC deal with Esteban Ocon
items.summaryEn: Toyota has denied it will sign Esteban Ocon for the World Endurance Championship in 2027, saying it does not want to jeopardise the harmony within its driver lineups. This follows Haas officially announcing it will end its partnership with the 30-year-old Frenchman at the conclusion of the 2026 season.
detailZh: 丰田否认2027年与奥孔达成WEC协议
这家日本制造商不想破坏其车手阵容内部的和谐
奥孔在F1的选择正逐渐减少，而丰田不会在世界耐力锦标赛（WEC）为他提供席位。
在哈斯车队本周官宣将在2026赛季结束后结束与这位30岁法国车手的合作之后，媒体上关于奥孔职业生涯下一步去向的猜测甚嚣尘上。
随着阿斯顿·马丁确认将继续留用阿隆索和斯特罗尔，凯迪拉克实际上成为奥孔在一级方程式中最后一个现实的选择。
这也正是他还与转投世界耐力锦标赛的可能性联系在一起的原因——可能加盟丰田。但丰田顾问亚历山大·伍尔茨现已向Motorsport.com姊妹刊物Formel1.de的YouTube频道明确表示：“这些传闻毫无根据。”
伍尔茨表示，丰田在勒芒及其世界耐力锦标赛项目上通常会做“相当长远的”规划，目前不打算对现有的六人车手阵容做出任何调整。
“因为当你把三个强势个性放进同一辆赛车时，他们需要时间去彼此接受，去找到正确的调校和正确的合作方式，并达到这样一个阶段：他们不再在内部互相竞争，而是真正激发出彼此的最佳状态。这是一个非常重要的区别，”这位奥地利人解释道。
#8 丰田Gazoo Racing 丰田TR010：塞巴斯蒂安·布耶米、布伦登·哈特利、平川亮
"这是丰田的优势之一：我们拥有这样的车队架构和车队文化，而这种东西不可能一夜之间改变。
"首先，我们签的是长期合同。其次，你不可能随便从外面引进一名车手，直接把他塞进车手阵容里。那样做恰恰有可能破坏我们自2012年以来一直建立并悉心呵护的文化。维护这种文化是我作为顾问、作为与车手密切合作的人的主要职责之一。
他还补充道："但不管你怎么看，这些合同都是长期的，而且我们明年的车手阵容已经百分之百满了。"
丰田目前参加世界耐力锦标赛（WEC），一台车由迈克·康威、尼克·德弗里斯和小林可梦伟驾驶，另一台车由塞巴斯蒂安·布埃米、布伦登·哈特利和平川亮驾驶。这家日本厂商刚刚在家乡富士赛道赢得胜利，在惊心动魄的尾声中，本地英雄平川亮完成了决定胜负的最后一段驾驶。
detailEn: Toyota denies 2027 WEC deal with Esteban Ocon
The Japanese manufacturer doesn't want to jeopardise the harmony within its driver lineups
Esteban Ocon’s Formula 1 options are gradually running out, and Toyota will not provide one in the WEC.

After Haas officially announced this week that it will end its partnership with the 30-year-old Frenchman at the conclusion of the 2026 season, media speculation has been rife over where Ocon’s career might take him next.
With Aston Martin having confirmed that it will continue with Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll, Cadillac effectively remains Ocon's last realistic option in Formula 1.

That is why he has also been linked with a possible switch to the World Endurance Championship – potentially with Toyota. But Toyota advisor Alexander Wurz has now made it clear to Motorsport.com sister publication Formel1.de’s YouTube channel: "There's nothing to these rumours."
Wurz said that Toyota generally plans "relatively far ahead" when it comes to Le Mans and its WEC programme, and that no changes to its current six-driver line-up are planned.

"Because when you put three alpha personalities in one car, it takes time for them to accept each other, to find the right set-up and the right way of working together, and to reach a point where they don't compete against each other internally but actually bring out the best in one another. That's a very important distinction," the Austrian explained.
#8 Toyota Gazoo Racing Toyota TR010: Sebastien Buemi, Brendon Hartley, Ryo Hirakawa
"That's one of Toyota's strengths: we have this team structure and this team culture, and you can't simply change that overnight.

"First of all, we have long-term contracts. And secondly, you can't just bring in another driver from the outside and slot him into the line-up. That would risk disrupting exactly the culture we've been building and nurturing since 2012. Maintaining that culture is one of my main responsibilities as an advisor and someone who works closely with the drivers.
He added: "But whichever way you look at it, the contracts are long-term and our line-up for next year is 100% full."

Toyota currently competes in the WEC with Mike Conway, Nyck de Vries and Kamui Kobayashi in one car, and Sebastien Buemi, Brendon Hartley and Ryo Hirakawa in the other. The Japanese manufacturer has just won its home race at Fuji, following a thrilling finish with local hero Hirakawa at the wheel for the decisive stint.
keyPointsZh: 丰田拒绝签约的理由是不希望破坏其车手阵容内部的和谐
奥孔的F1选择正逐渐减少
哈斯官宣合作将于2026赛季结束后终止，引发外界对其去向的大量猜测
keyPointsEn: Toyota's reason for declining is that it does not want to jeopardise the harmony within its driver lineups
Ocon's Formula 1 options are gradually running out
Haas's announcement that the partnership ends after 2026 has sparked widespread speculation about his next move

items.titleZh: 本田秘密在马德里站引入第二个ADUO升级
items.summaryZh: 本田赛车公司社长渡边浩司透露，本田实际上早在西班牙大奖赛就引入了本赛季第二个额外开发与升级机会升级，重点针对动力单元的涡轮增压器。

items.originalTitle: Honda secretly introduced second F1 ADUO upgrade in Madrid
items.summaryEn: Honda Racing Corporation president Koji Watanabe has revealed that Honda introduced its second ADUO (Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities) upgrade as early as the Spanish Grand Prix, focusing on the power unit's turbocharger.
detailZh: 本田秘密在马德里引入第二个F1 ADUO升级
本田赛车公司（HRC）透露，本田本赛季F1的第二个ADUO升级是新的涡轮增压器，早在西班牙大奖赛就已引入。
本田赛车公司社长渡边浩司透露，本田实际上早在F1西班牙大奖赛就引入了第二个额外开发与升级机会升级，重点针对动力单元的涡轮增压器。
阿斯顿·马丁和本田从赛季开始时表现挣扎，但在亨格罗林引入重大底盘升级后表现略有改善。在赞德沃特，车队还引入了搭载第一个ADUO升级的动力单元。
据测量，本田的内燃机（ICE）比红牛福特动力总成的引擎落后超过4%，后者被评为输出功率最高的引擎，这意味着本田获准在赛季中使用两个空气动力学升级配额令牌。
本田和HRC此前曾解释说，他们只会使用其中一次ADUO机会。“我们两次都用了，”渡边在接受Motorsport.com网站采访时透露，当时他被问到为什么本田决定只使用一次ADUO升级。
“我们在荷兰引入了第一次ADUO升级，然后在西班牙大奖赛上，我们把一套包含第二次升级的动力单元装到了斯特罗尔的车上。
“我们在荷兰引入的2号规格动力单元存在一些可驾驶性问题，所以我们在西班牙大奖赛上引入了一个改进版的涡轮增压器。”
事实上，国际汽联的动力单元部件使用清单显示，斯特罗尔的赛车在西班牙大奖赛时已经用上了本赛季的第五个涡轮增压器。费尔南多·阿隆索的赛车也在阿塞拜疆大奖赛装上了第五个涡轮增压器，而这看起来就是升级版本。
当被问及目标是否是解决涡轮迟滞问题时，渡边回答说：“是的。”他随后解释了分阶段引入升级部件的思路。
“如果我们能一次性把所有东西都引入当然更好，但首先在荷兰引入规格2（Spec 2）非常重要。与此同时，我们也在研究解决涡轮迟滞的对策，所以在西班牙引入了这部分。
“因此，应用最终被分成了两部分。”
不过渡边也表示，本田仍未完全发挥其动力单元的全部潜力。
本田此前为红牛供应引擎时，不被允许引入性能升级，但仍继续利用模拟来确定动力单元的运行极限，并逐年逐步提高这些极限。这就是本田所说的“可靠性研发”。
例如，红牛在2024年采用了极其窄小的侧箱，同时也缩小了用于引入冷却气流的开口尺寸。这也得益于提高动力单元的运行极限才得以实现。
“就ADUO而言，我们已经用完了本赛季的升级机会。从这里开始，我们将继续在不涉及硬件的方面下功夫，同时也进行面向未来发展的研发。”渡边说道。
我认为我们距离完全发挥这套动力单元的全部性能还很远。我相信它的竞争力仍有提升空间。
此前仍有一些地方存在动力不足，因此我们带着明确的目标数值开发了第二版规格。我们已经达成了这些目标，所以在赛季剩余的时间里，我们的重点将放在充分利用现有成果上，而不是继续开发硬件。
即便如此，我们仍要确保自己能够真正地进行竞争。
detailEn: Honda secretly introduced second F1 ADUO upgrade in Madrid
Honda's second ADUO upgrade of the F1 season was a new turbocharger, already introduced at the Spanish Grand Prix, HRC reveals

Honda Racing Corporation president Koji Watanabe has revealed that Honda actually introduced its second ADUO (Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities) upgrade as early as Formula 1’s Spanish Grand Prix, with the upgrade focused on the power unit's turbocharger.

Aston Martin and Honda struggled from the start of the season, but their performance slightly improved after a major chassis upgrade was introduced at the Hungaroring. In Zandvoort, the team also introduced a power unit fitted with the first ADUO upgrade.

Honda's ICE was measured to be more than 4% behind the Red Bull Ford Powertrains engine, which was rated as having the highest output, meaning Honda was granted permission to use two ADUO tokens during the season.

Honda and HRC had previously explained that they would use only one of those ADUO opportunities. “We used both of them,” Watanabe revealed to Motorsport.com when asked why Honda had decided to use only one ADUO upgrade.
“We introduced the first ADUO upgrade in the Netherlands, and then we put a PU incorporating the second update into Lance Stroll's car at the Spanish Grand Prix.
“The Spec 2 PU we introduced in the Netherlands had some drivability issues, so we introduced an improved turbo at the Spanish Grand Prix.”

Indeed, the FIA's list of PU component usage shows that Stroll's car was fitted with its fifth turbocharger of the season at the Spanish GP. Fernando Alonso's car was also fitted with his fifth turbo, which would appear to be the upgraded version, at the Azerbaijan GP.
Asked whether the objective was to address turbo lag, Watanabe replied: “Yes.” He subsequently explained the thinking behind the staggered introduction of the upgrades.

“It would have been better if we could have introduced everything at once, but it was important to introduce Spec 2 in the Netherlands first. We were also working on measures to address the turbo lag in parallel, so we introduced that in Spain.
“So the application ended up being split between the two.”
Watanabe also said, however, that Honda is still not extracting the full potential of its power unit.

When Honda was previously supplying Red Bull, it was not allowed to introduce performance upgrades, but it continued to use simulations to determine the operating limits of the PU and gradually raise those limits year after year. This was what Honda referred to as “reliability development”.

For example, Red Bull adopted extremely small sidepods in 2024, while also reducing the size of the openings used to draw in airflow for cooling. This was also made possible by raising the PU's operating limits.

“As far as ADUO is concerned, we have used up our opportunities for this season. From here, we will continue working on things that don't involve hardware, as well as developments that will lead into the future”, Watanabe said.
“I don't think we are anywhere near extracting the full performance of the PU. I believe there is still room to improve its competitiveness.

“There were still areas where we were lacking power, so we developed Spec 2 with target figures in mind. We have achieved those targets, so for the remainder of the season, our focus will be on making full use of what we have, rather than continuing to develop the hardware.
“Even so, we want to make sure we are able to fight properly.”
keyPointsZh: 阿斯顿·马丁和本田从赛季开始时表现挣扎，但在亨格罗林引入重大底盘升级后表现略有改善。
在赞德沃特，车队还引入了搭载第一个ADUO升级的动力单元。
渡边浩司是本田赛车公司的社长。
keyPointsEn: Aston Martin and Honda struggled from the start of the season, but performance slightly improved after a major chassis upgrade at the Hungaroring.
In Zandvoort, the team also introduced a power unit fitted with the first ADUO upgrade.
Koji Watanabe is the president of Honda Racing Corporation.

items.summaryEn: Former Haas Formula 1 team principal Guenther Steiner has dismissed the possibility of Christian Horner and Fred Vasseur working alongside each other at Ferrari, joking that the talk is good publicity for his book. Horner told The Times that working with Ferrari would be "the dream" and the only team where he would accept a non-ownership role at this stage of his career.
detailZh: 京特·施泰纳调侃克里斯蒂安·霍纳与法拉利的传闻是给书做宣传
京特·施泰纳否认了克里斯蒂安·霍纳与弗雷德·瓦塞尔在法拉利共事的可能性
前哈斯一级方程式车队领队京特·施泰纳认为克里斯蒂安·霍纳和弗雷德·瓦塞尔在法拉利并肩工作的可能性不大。
关于霍纳未来去向的猜测在其接受《泰晤士报》采访后升温。霍纳表示他愿意考虑在马拉内罗车队担任领导职务。霍纳称与法拉利合作是"梦想"，并表示在他职业生涯的这个阶段，法拉利是他唯一愿意接受非所有者职位的车队。
在《红旗播客》节目中，施泰纳表示，霍纳只是在调整自己的策略，以求重返争冠行列，还打趣说他可能是想为自己的新书做些宣传。
“我认为克里斯蒂安想回到一级方程式，而且他说得很清楚，他不想再为任何人打工了。显然，他的A计划行不通，于是他就转向B计划，而如果他去了法拉利工作，就拿不到那里的股份，”施泰纳说。“我认为他想进去，并且他在那里看到了一个机会。”
他补充道：“另外，这对他来说也没有什么坏处。他要出一本书，这会有助于那本书的销售，或者也许没帮助，我们不知道，但至少算是有一点宣传。”
施泰纳还回应了关于霍纳与瓦塞尔在法拉利共事的问题，并否定了这种可能性。
"我认为弗雷德留在那里为克里斯蒂安工作的情况不会发生,"他说。"弗雷德本人是一个非常成功的人。但首先,我不知道弗雷德是否想离开,或者他是否不得不离开。
"说到底,弗雷德手上有一份合同,而在一级方程式里这些合同又值多少钱呢?我猜并不多,但那里没有容纳他们两个人的空间。这就是我的看法。那种情况不会发生。"
detailEn: Guenther Steiner jokes Christian Horner Ferrari talk is good book publicity
Guenther Steiner has dismissed the prospect of Christian Horner and Fred Vasseur working together at Ferrari
Former Haas Formula 1 team principal Guenther Steiner has dismissed the possibility of Christian Horner and Fred Vasseur working alongside each other at Ferrari.

Speculation regarding Horner's future intensified after he told The Times he would consider a leadership role at the Maranello outfit. Horner described working with Ferrari as "the dream" and indicated it is the only team at which he would accept a non-ownership position at this stage of his career.
Speaking on The Red Flags Podcast, Steiner suggested Horner is simply adapting his strategy to return to the championship and joked that he could be getting some publicity for his new book.

"I think Christian wants to come back to Formula 1, and he said clearly that he doesn't want to work for anybody anymore. Obviously, plan A for him doesn't work out, so he goes to plan B and he doesn't get a stake in Ferrari if he goes to work there," Steiner said. "I think he wants to come in and he sees an opportunity there."

He added: "The other thing, there's nothing bad for him in it as well. He's releasing a book so it will help the sale of that one, or maybe not, we don't know, but at least it's a little bit of publicity."
Steiner also addressed questions about Horner and Vasseur working together at Ferrari and dismissed the possibility.

"I don't think that's going to happen that Fred is staying there working for Christian," he said. "Fred in himself is a very successful guy. But first of all, I don't know that Fred wants to leave or that he has to leave.
"In the end, Fred has got a contract and how much are they worth in Formula 1? Not a lot, I guess, but there is not space for the two of them. That's my opinion on it. That is not going to happen."
keyPointsZh: 霍纳告诉《泰晤士报》，他愿意考虑在马拉内罗车队担任领导职务
霍纳形容与法拉利合作是"梦想"，并称这是他现阶段唯一愿意接受非所有者职位的车队

items.originalTitle: Kimi Antonelli has "spooked himself" amid F1 title pressure, says Naomi Schiff
items.summaryEn: Pundit Naomi Schiff believes championship leader Kimi Antonelli has "spooked himself" and must "get out of his head" to avoid crumbling under the pressure of the Formula 1 title fight.
detailZh: 娜奥米·希夫：安东内利在F1争冠压力下"吓到了自己"
娜奥米·希夫认为领跑积分榜的基米·安东内利必须克服F1争冠带来的心理压力。
评论员娜奥米·希夫表示，积分榜领跑者基米·安东内利已经"吓到了自己"，必须"摆脱心理包袱"，以避免在F1争冠的压力下崩溃。
这位梅赛德斯车手带着81分的巨大领先优势来到阿塞拜疆大奖赛。但队友乔治·拉塞尔成功将杆位转化为分站冠军，而安东内利从第16位发车后仅获第五名，优势因此缩小到66分。
在“Up To Speed”播客节目中，前女子系列赛（W Series）车手、天空体育F1评论员希夫警告说，这位意大利车手在巴库的身体语言表明，他开始感受到首次争夺总冠军所带来的压力。
“我感觉这个周末我在赛道上观察基米时，不仅是他在排位赛中犯的那个错误，还有他在赛道上的整体状态，感觉就像一个正在为总冠军而战的车手，但几乎把自己吓得有点过头了，”希夫解释道。
“所以他在车里感觉有点僵硬，因为他不想犯错。而那也不是一个正确的状态。”
她补充说：“他只需要摆脱心里的杂念。这种情况以前也发生过。上赛季他也经常陷入自己的思绪中。他设法控制住了，之后开车就更放得开了。赛季开始时，他焕然一新。”
“我真的希望他不会因为想太多而把自己吓住，因为这事其实很简单。这完全是心理博弈，一旦钻进牛角尖，你就会开始担心各种事情，而这些担心往往会自己应验。所以我希望他能放轻松、放开自己。”
尽管安东内利在巴库度过了艰难的一个周末，他目前在车手总冠军积分榜上仍然以66分的优势领先排名第二的队友拉塞尔。
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli has "spooked himself" amid F1 title pressure, says Naomi Schiff
Naomi Schiff believes championship leader Kimi Antonelli must overcome the psychological pressure of his Formula 1 title fight
Championship leader Kimi Antonelli has "spooked himself" and must "get out of his head" to avoid crumbling under the pressure of the Formula 1 fight, according to pundit Naomi Schiff.

The Mercedes driver arrived at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix with a commanding 81-point lead. But that advantage was reduced to 66 points after team-mate George Russell successfully converted pole position to a race win, while Antonelli finished fifth after starting from 16th on the grid.

Speaking on the Up To Speed podcast, former W Series driver and Sky Sports F1 pundit Schiff warned that the Italian driver's body language in Baku suggested he was starting to feel the pressure of his maiden championship fight.

"I felt like when I was looking at Kimi on track this weekend and not just the mistake that he made [in qualifying], but just his general demeanour on track, it felt like a driver who's driving for that championship, but has almost spooked himself a little bit too much," Schiff explained.
"So he feels a little bit stiff in the car because he doesn't want to make a mistake. And that's also not the right place to be in."

She added: "He just needs to get out of his head. And we've seen it happen before. Last season he was in his head a lot as well. He managed to get that under control, and then he was driving more freely. He came into the beginning of the season a new man.

"I really hope that he's not going to spook himself out of this because it is so easy. It's such a psychological game that once you get in your head, you start worrying about things. You almost bring those things to yourself. So I hope he can free himself up."
Although Antonelli endured a difficult weekend in Baku, he still holds a 66-point lead in the drivers' championship over his team-mate Russell, who sits in second.

items.originalTitle: George Russell details F1 drivers' Langkawi boys' trip ahead of Bahrain GP in Malaysia
items.summaryEn: Mercedes driver George Russell has shared details of a boys' trip to Langkawi with six other Formula 1 drivers, which included a local go-karting race, ahead of this weekend's Bahrain Grand Prix.
detailZh: 拉塞尔详细讲述了F1车手们的兰卡威之旅
拉塞尔透露了在巴林大奖赛前F1车手们前往兰卡威旅行的细节
梅赛德斯车手拉塞尔分享了与好友们前往兰卡威度假的细节，行程中包括一场当地卡丁车比赛，此行安排在本周末的巴林大奖赛之前。
拉塞尔在Instagram上发布了此次与六位F1车手同行的照片，他们分别是奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里、亚历克斯·阿尔本、奥利弗·比尔曼、卡洛斯·塞恩斯、加布里埃尔·博托莱托和兰多·诺里斯。
照片显示这群人在瀑布前合影、玩卡丁车、下棋，还有诺里斯拍摄他的迈凯伦队友的画面，大概是在为他的Prime纪录片系列拍摄素材。
在吉隆坡双子塔举行的新闻发布会上，拉塞尔接受了包括Motorsport.com在内的媒体采访，他解释说这次行程安排受到了梅赛德斯冠名合作伙伴马石油的影响。
“所以我们和其他六位车手一起去了，我们度过了一段非常美好的时光。那是一个非常非常美丽的地方。那里的人们非常友好，感觉像是身处一个不同的世界。所以我非常享受那次旅行，这是为本周做准备的完美方式。”
拉塞尔的队友安东内利也提前抵达马来西亚，但他利用这段时间游览了吉隆坡，还去了一个水上乐园。
“我玩得非常开心，”目前的积分榜领跑者解释道。“人很少，所以我可以反复去玩滑梯。大约三分钟里我把同一条滑梯玩了五次，所以就是不停地跑上跑下。感觉很好。”
“除此之外，我一直在马来西亚这里，在市区四处转转。总体来说，能看到吉隆坡真的很酷。我没有尝试任何传统美食，因为，嗯，也许等这个周末之后再说吧……”
在拉塞尔于阿塞拜疆大奖赛夺冠之后，安东内利带着66分的积分榜领先优势进入（在马来西亚之后举行的）巴林大奖赛。
detailEn: George Russell details F1 drivers' Langkawi boys' trip ahead of Bahrain GP in Malaysia
George Russell has revealed details of a Formula 1 drivers' trip to Langkawi ahead of the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia
Mercedes driver George Russell has shared details of a boys' trip to Langkawi, which included a local go-karting race, ahead of this weekend's Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia.
Taking to Instagram, Russell posted photographs of the trip with six other Formula 1 drivers: Oscar Piastri, Alex Albon, Oliver Bearman, Carlos Sainz, Gabriel Bortoleto and Lando Norris.
The photos show the group posing in front of a waterfall, go-karting, and playing chess, as well as Norris filming his McLaren team-mate, presumably for his Prime docuseries.
Speaking to media, including Motorsport.com, at a press conference at the Petronas Towers in Kuala Lumpur, Russell explained the itinerary was influenced by Mercedes title partner Petronas.

"So we went with six other drivers, and we had a really amazing time. It's such a beautiful, beautiful place. The people are so friendly, and it felt like a different world being there. So I really enjoyed that, and it was the perfect way to prepare for this week."
Russell's team-mate Kimi Antonelli also arrived in Malaysia early, but instead used his time to explore Kuala Lumpur and go to a water park.

"I had a lot of fun," the current championship leader explained. "There were few people, so I could go on the slide repeatedly. I did the same slide five times in like three minutes, so I was just running up and down. It was good.

"And then other than that, I've been here in Malaysia, I've been going around the city. It was really cool to see KL in general. I didn't try any traditional food because, yeah, maybe after the weekend..."
Antonelli heads into the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia with a 66-point lead in the standings after Russell's win at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix.
